findings.title: Missing scope and duration details for site establishment
findings.message: The short and long text only state "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" without specifying the required facilities, duration, or performance criteria, which violates VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 (clear and exhaustive description).
findings.suggestion: Specify the exact facilities (e.g., offices, storage, sanitation), their dimensions, and the period of provision.

findings.title: Missing Homogenbereich specification for earthworks
findings.message: The description "Boden gemäß Baugrubenprofil lösen und ausheben" lacks the required Homogenbereich (soil class) as required by STLB‑Bau standard (DIN 18300), which is a mandatory technical specification.
findings.suggestion: Add the Homogenbereich (e.g., B1, B2) and any relevant geotechnical parameters.

findings.title: Unspecified frost protection material type
findings.message: The text only mentions "Frostschutzmaterial liefern und nach Vorgabe einbauen" without naming the material class, thermal conductivity or thickness, which are required for compliance with VOB/C technical specifications.
findings.suggestion: State the material type (e.g., granular, geotextile), class, and required thickness.

findings.title: Missing concrete class and reinforcement details for shaft
findings.message: The description "Schacht DN 1000 aus Betonfertigteilen herstellen" does not specify concrete strength class, exposure class, or reinforcement requirements, which are mandatory under VOB/C.
findings.suggestion: Add concrete class (e.g., C25/30), exposure class (e.g., XC4), and reinforcement layout.

findings.title: Missing concrete grade and execution specifications
findings.message: The phrase "Beton liefern und einbauen" lacks concrete grade, exposure class, and any auxiliary works (e.g., formwork, curing), which are required by VOB/C.
findings.suggestion: Specify concrete class (e.g., C30/37), exposure class, and indicate whether formwork and curing are included or separate.

findings.title: Foreign currency clause in payment terms
findings.message: The long text states "Abrechnung in USD", which shifts exchange‑rate risk to the contractor and may be deemed an unfair clause under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Change the payment currency to EUR or include a clear, mutually agreed exchange‑rate mechanism.

findings.title: Missing insulation thickness and thermal conductivity
findings.message: The description "Wärmedämmplatten liefern und vollflächig verlegen" does not state the required thickness, material type, or thermal conductivity, which are mandatory for thermal performance verification.
findings.suggestion: Add insulation type, thickness (e.g., 100 mm), and WLS value.

findings.title: Use of outdated norm and missing water‑impact class
findings.message: The text refers to "Bodenklasse 3–5 nach alter DIN 18195" which is obsolete; current VOB/C requires specification of Homogenbereich and water‑impact class (e.g., W‑Klasse).
findings.suggestion: Replace the reference with the current Homogenbereich and state the required water‑impact class.

findings.title: Duplicate site establishment position
findings.message: Position 2.1.4.50 repeats the content of 2.1.1.10 (identical short and long text, same unit), creating a potential double payment.
findings.reference: VOB/B § 2 Abs. 6 (additional services must be clearly distinguished)
findings.suggestion: Consolidate the two positions or clearly differentiate scope and timing.

findings.title: Potential duplicate earthwork position
findings.message: The description mirrors 2.1.1.40 (same activity, same quantity) which may lead to double counting.
findings.suggestion: Verify whether the two positions refer to different phases; if not, merge them.

findings.title: Duplicate earthwork position
findings.message: Identical to 2.1.1.40 in wording and quantity, risking double remuneration.
findings.suggestion: Clarify distinct scope or remove redundancy.

findings.title: Duplicate disposal position
findings.message: Same description and quantity as 2.1.1.50, which may cause double payment.
findings.suggestion: Combine or differentiate the two positions.

findings.title: Duplicate frost protection position
findings.message: Identical to 2.1.1.60, leading to possible double billing.
findings.suggestion: Merge the positions or allocate distinct responsibilities.

findings.title: Unfair risk allocation clause in pre‑notes
findings.message: The pre‑note "Unvorhersehbare Risiken gehen vollständig zu Lasten des AN" shifts all unforeseeable risks to the contractor, which may be deemed an unreasonable clause under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Introduce a balanced risk allocation, e.g., share unforeseeable risks according to statutory rules.

findings.title: Exclusion of change orders in pre‑notes
findings.message: The clause "Nachforderungen sind ausgeschlossen" attempts to pre‑emptively exclude all change orders, which may be ineffective under VOB/B § 2 Abs. 6 and § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Allow for reasonable change orders with clear procedural rules.
